Beer: Voltova 10th Anniversary Edition - Collab with Linc Malt
Description: The fact we were celebrating our 10 year anniversary while Linc Malt was enjoying theirs meant it was obvious what we had to do: Clearly we needed to brew a special edition of our flagship Czech-Style Pale Lager (a 10° Plato Světlý Výčepní) using only ingredients local to the Pacific Northwest. The base of this beer is Linc’s famous Baronesse Pilsner (you may know this malt from local legend Douglas Lager) combined with a modest percentage of Baronesse Vienna malt. This edition was also hopped exclusively with Idaho-grown Saaz hops, but the recipe is otherwise true to the Voltova you know and love: fermented cold and slow, spunded for natural carbonation, and lagered ice-cold. The malt character is snappy and crisp, with aromas of hay and fresh grass, plus light crackery notes. The hop character is assertively floral and bitter with a peppery spice complexity. Light, crisp, and excessively drinkable.

Beer: Bird Search - 10th Anniversary Collab with Human People
Description: For our 10th anniversary, we we're thrilled to make a special beer with our friends and neighbors at Human People Beer Cafe. There was no doubt it should showcase a metric ton of Mosaic, and we took it a step further by loading up on a variety of hop products for a maximalist approach to this beloved style. Bird Search was brewed with a simple base of pilsner malt and a dash of chit malt, allowing the excessive hopping to shine without distraction. In the boil, we used Simcoe Cryo, Columbus Cryo, and Mosaic, while adding more Mosaic, Columbus Cryo, and Mosaic Incognito in the whirlpool. At knockout, we threw in a new product from Yakima Chief Hops: Mosaic 803 (supercritical CO2 extract). We also added beta-glucosidase, an exogenous enzyme aiding in the biotransformation of flavorless hop compounds into aromatic terpenes during fermentation. After fermentation, we dry-hopped with Mosaic, Mosaic Cryo, Riwaka, and a smidge of Columbus Cryo. FINALLY, we dosed the bright tank with Riwaka SubZero Hop Kief from Freestyle Hops, for even MORE lupulin. The result is absolutely saturated in hop oils, deftly balancing tropical fruit, citrus, berries, and sticky cannabis. Loud aromas of grapefruit hard candy and guava juice lead into flavors of tangerine gummies, fresh mixed berries, and resinous weed. A pleasant pithy bitterness lingers through the dry finish.

Everything old is new again... Future Echoes showcases a classic trio of Mosaic, Amarillo, and Centennial hops for punchy notes of pine and grapefruit.
A preview of our soon-to-be released permanently available Pale Ale! Modern, West-Coast style pale with Riwaka and Mosaic hops.
Lemon Shandy! What is it? Helles Lager with lemon puree. light, refreshing, crushable with notes of fresh squeezed lemonade and long summer nights.

pils\wheat Hazy Triple IPA notes of mangoes, white peach and stiff mai-tai's.
 Hops: Simcoe, Citra, Rawaka

CiderCraft Double Gold Winner! Apples and Pears purrrfectly go together in this limited edition cider. It's a delightful balance of fresh juices that make this one an easy sipper or blended with some of our other ciders like CinnaBEAR for that warm spiced pear treat.

CiderCraft Judges' Pick Winner! The fox side of Slightly Furry started with this blend of Apple, Cinnamon, and Brown sugar as their first homebrew batch back in 2013. It was such a hit amongst their friends that they kept making more while they kept asking when it would be for sale. That feedback began the idea of Slightly Furry as we know today. So, we are bringing back the classic for you to enjoy any time of the year and be instantly transported into fall amongst gatherings of furry friends.

PineappOWL pays homage to our first investor, taste tester, and biggest cheerleader. We crafted this cider after his original Owl fursona as a thank you for his ongoing support, balancing the bright flavor that pineapple is known for with more apple juice to tame the acidity. Lay back with a nice book and this cider in your claws for some summertime beach vibes.
Cream Ale steeped with Earl Gray tea leaves.
West Coast IPA dry hopped with Abstrax Brewgas - Sour Tangie
A big, bold, roasty stout brewed on a base of American 2-Row and Maris Otter malts and then aged in bourbon barrels.
We're proud to brew a West Coast IPA celebrating Seattle Pride and the 2026 Pride Match. Citrus ,passionfruit and Proud AF.

We honor tradition by brewing this beer using decoction mashing techniques and fermenting with a German yeast strain that imparts prominent banana and clove notes. The wheat gives this beer a crisp, slightly tart, refreshing finish.

German pilsner malt is the backbone for this clean, crisp German-style lager. A gentle malt sweetness teased out through traditional decoction brewing methods is balanced by German noble hops making for a spicy, bright finish.
German Pilsner brewed with Mittelfruh and Spalt hops. With notes of wildflowers, and lemon peel.
West Coast IPA brewed with Nelson, Simcoe, and Citra bursting with aromas of mango and pomelo.
Traditional Sour Smoothie! Strawberries, Tart Cherries, Sweet Cherries, and Cheesecake!

Style/ABV: Traditional Sour Smoothie! Pineapple, Mango, Passion Fruit, and Coconut! 7.2% abv
Description: Our Flagship IPA is brewed with our favorite blend of malts and oats, and double-dry hopped with Galaxy, Citra, and Mosaic. Showcasing aromas of passionfruit, cantaloupe, and pineapple gummies.

A massive imperial brunch stout aged for two years in bourbon barrels, then finished with coffee, cinnamon, and maple syrup. Rich layers of dark chocolate, espresso, maple candy, bourbon caramel, and toasted oak lead into a velvety, warming finish built for serious stout lovers.
Tropical passionfruit, bright orange and juicy guava with light notes of coconut from a thoughtful Sabro dry hopping. Full flavored, juicy, and easy drinking.

A crisp, easy-drinking blonde ale with bright, subtle raspberry character and a clean, refreshing finish. Light-bodied and perfectly balanced, this two-time Double Gold SIP Award winner delivers fresh berry aroma without overpowering sweetness.
A light, crackery malt base supports delicate floral, herbal and spicy hop notes in this crisp German Style Pilsner that’s mildly bitter and endlessly refreshing.
A crisp and true to the terroir contemporary West Coast IPA bursting with tropical fruit, citrus, stone fruit as well as subtle floral and resinous pine notes.
Fresh WA apple juice fermented on an English Ale yeast strain and then conditioned on loads of locally grown blueberries and raspberries.
German-Style Pilsner built on Pilsen and Dextra Pils malts, balanced with Millennium and Hallertau Mittelfruh hops, and fermented with Augustiner Lager yeast.
German Hefeweizen with blood orange added to the secondary fermentation. Built on Two-Row and White Wheat malts, with a simple dose of Millennium hops, and fermented with Hefeweizen yeast.

West Coast IPA brewed in partnership with the Washington Wolfpack Arena Football team based out of Everett. Brewed with Two-Row, Marris Otter, Carapils, and Munich malts, hopped with Columbus, Centennial, and a huge dose of Mandarina Bavaria hops, and fermented with Safale US-05 yeast.
English Brown Ale built on a complex mix of Two-Row, Amber, Crystal 60, and Chocalte malts, hopped exclusively with East Kent Goldings hops, and fermented with London Ale III yeast.
We take your favourite Mosaic hops and throw in some Dolcita in this drinkable hazy IPA. Big peach energy with a pineapple and tropical finish.

Inspired by cherry pie made at Ben's Bread, this collaboration with them and Ridgewood is reminiscent of tart cherry with a dominant cinnamon and background note of clove! Pink/red, sour/tart, crisp, cherry and cinnamon forward.

Beer: There's No Such Thing As Seagull's Oliver!
Description:
8.1% ABV - Wild Ale re-fermented on whole Syrah grapes
 
 We continue our wild collaboration with our friend Oliver May from Discover Vineyard (Horse Heaven Hills AVA), celebrating Chris & Oliver’s mentor, conservationist Dr. Steven Herman. This beer was blended from selected wine barrel aged wild ale aged in red wine barrels, then re-fermented for about a year on lightly crushed Syrah grapes with a small portion of Petite Verdot grapes added, before allowing the beer to condition naturally. This beer features a mild acidity with bright red berry flavor and a touch of black pepper. The deep red color of this beer comes from the long contact time with the Syrah grape skins.

Crisp, clear, and ULTRA refreshing, this light-bodied ale is perfect for quaffing on the patio while the grill is getting warmed up. El Dorado hops peek through in the aroma and finish leaving you needing another, and another, and another sip.

Our most popular beer, the tropical & citrus flavors in SUP CUZ IPA come from Amarillo, Cascade, Comet & Citra, all hops grown by our close friends at Loza Farms in Wapato. Very light bodied for the style, this beer is perfect paired a relaxed afternoon with family and friends.

Ribbit Robot: Super Krush is a double dry-hopped IPA with Krush and Citra on the hot side and a dry hop of Krush, Citra Hyperboost, Citra Cryo and Rakau! The result is a KRUSHable banger with new artwork by @mayfair_pdx! Tropical fruit medley meets pillowy mouthfeel with a nose full of white grape, grapefruit and citrus peel. Sneaky at 8.25%.

Somewhere between Cybertron and Kilroy’s hideout, this Rice Lager was engineered for one purpose: maximum crushability.
 
 Mr. Roboto powers up with a clean, crisp malt profile, a smooth rice-lager glide, and a finish so snappy it might just transform your afternoon. Light, bright, and refreshingly precise, it’s built for humans, Autobots, and suspiciously emotional synth-pop androids alike.
A last resort Mexican Lager with lime juice and lime zest.

Beer: The Last of the Big Dawgz
Description:
The Last of the Big Dawgz is a West Coast IPA brewed as a loving nod to our former head brewer, Aaron Copelin — a NorCal original known for rocking socks with sandals, cruising in a Subaru Forester with California plates, and calling just about everybody Big Dog.
 
 Just like the man himself, this beer is classic, unbothered, and full of character: bright citrus, piney bitterness, a little dankness, and a crisp, clean finish that keeps things moving. Columbus and Simcoe lay down the old-school backbone, while Krush, Mosaic, Nelson, and Mosaic Cryo ride shotgun for a punchy modern hop blast.
 
 A little Northern California attitude, a little Pacific Northwest polish, and a whole lot of Big Dog energy.

This West Coast IPA is coming at you from deep in Sector 441 in the Beta Quadrant. Made with Great Western malts Loaded with Comet, Cascade and Citra, The Riker Maneuver hits with citrus, melon, pine resin and a rounded bitterness. Please enjoy responsibly and please refrain from swinging your leg over the chair when you sit down. Not everyone can pull that off like the galaxy’s favorite playboy

Brewed by Jamie, one of Volition’s founders, Common Ground is a toast to resilience, connection, and the joy found in shared moments. Crisp, light, and layered with citrus, melon, and pine from Strata, Citra, and Mosaic hops, this West Coast Pilsner is easy to drink, easy to share, and made for everyone.

Our latest release is a fruited hazy IPA bursting with pineapple, passion fruit, and guava — it’s juicy, tropical, and just a little bit wild. Just like that epic beach party in The Lost Boys. (You know the one — saxophones blazing, bonfires roaring, pure 80s magic.

Not all royalty lives in the Mushroom Kingdom. This golden sour starts with a delicate base of Pilsner malt, white wheat malt, and flaked barley before being loaded with generous amounts of apricot and lemon purée. 
  
 A subtle touch of ginger rounds out the finish, adding just enough depth without stealing the spotlight. The result is bright, refreshing, and beautifully layered—bursting with juicy stone fruit, vibrant citrus, clean acidity, and a whisper of spice.

Our flagship beer is a bright, crisp take on the ales of Köln, Germany. We took the precision of this classic German style and adapted it to the American palate with PNW-grown hops, producing a beer of surprising depth and nuance for such a refreshing style.

Our signature rye ale features the earthy and faintly spicy quality of malted rye, interwoven with Yakima-grown Mt Hood hops. The result is a malt forward, yet dry balance with subtle fruit-like fermentation character and moderate hop bitterness.

Our rotating line of IPAs is all about hops. Each release showcases a different blend of hops over a crisp, dry bed of pale malt. Join us on this hop odyssey as we explore new varieties from the PNW and from around the globe!
2021 Washington Beer Awards Silver Medal Hazy IPA. This easy-drinkin' New England Style Hazy IPA features Tropical Fruit and a pleasantly complex hop profile.
60's Recipe Brewed with Olympia Head Brewer.
Brewed in Collaboration with Famed Home Brewer “Muffin Man”. Made with Lemon Grass, Ginger, and Lemon Peel. Fermented with French Saison Yeast.

Beer: Casa Mia Restaurant Birra La Rossa
Description: Birra la Rossa is a classic Italian style dopplebock lager, featuring complex flavors of sweet malt and toasted grains. It's malty profile is enhanced with subtle bitterness from European hops.

Bright, light and refreshing with the bite of
 bittersweet apples. Bright notes of citrus,
 hints of orange and lime dance with flavors
 of tropical fruit, making this a very refreshing
 but hard to define cider.
This cider is packed with the refreshing taste of peach, lemon, and a touch of mint. Tart and juicy all at the same time. Some of our favorite flavors of the season!
